scripts.test:e2e: cargo build -p apex-daemon --features test-support --bin apex-daemon-fixture && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs
scripts.desktop: cargo build -p apex-daemon --features remote && vite build && electron .
scripts.desktop:dev: cargo build -p apex-daemon --features remote && node desktop/dev.mjs
scripts.desktop:smoke: cargo build -p apex-daemon --features remote && vite build && node desktop/run-smoke.mjs
scripts.desktop:smoke:answers: cargo build -p apex-daemon --features remote && npm run build && node desktop/run-answers-smoke.mjs
scripts._desktop:package: cargo build --release -p apex-daemon --features remote && cargo build --release -p apex-provenance && vite build && node scripts/package-mac.mjs
scripts.desktop:smoke:multi-host: cargo build -p apex-daemon --features remote && vite build && node --experimental-strip-types desktop/run-multi-host-smoke.mjs
scripts.iphone:sync: node scripts/build-phone.mjs && scripts/build-iroh-mobile.sh && cap sync ios
scripts.iphone:open: npm run iphone:sync && cap open ios
